answer: Require every agent to lock a refundable deposit before it can trade. One deposit buys one identity, so a thousand fake agents means a thousand deposits frozen. Peers can slash the deposit when an agent cheats, and the loss stays on the record like a flaw in an opal: visible to anyone who checks. A whisper of bad behaviour spreads fast because every trade leaves a signed receipt, and the echo of that receipt follows the agent's key across markets. Faking volume then costs real money instead of just spawning new names.
